{
  "sprint_goal": "Deliver MVP of centralized ML feature store with Feast, Redis, and Databricks providing registry, batch jobs, real-time serving, and secure access control.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Design Feast feature registry schema with metadata and versioning",
      "description": "Define schema for feature registry including name, owner, version, lineage, and metadata fields. Configure Feast backend on Databricks and enable version tracking.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 12.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Implement batch feature computation using Databricks Spark jobs",
      "description": "Create Spark jobs to compute and update features hourly and daily in Delta tables. Configure job scheduling and ensure no duplication occurs across runs.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 10.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Integrate Redis with Feast for real-time feature serving",
      "description": "Set up Redis cluster for online feature serving, integrate with Feast online store interface, and validate latency under 10ms (p99) for 50 feature requests.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Develop point-in-time correct join logic for training datasets",
      "description": "Implement feature retrieval using timestamp-based join logic to ensure data correctness and prevent leakage in training data extraction.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Setup feature monitoring and drift detection pipeline",
      "description": "Implement monitoring scripts to compute statistics between offline and online stores, detect drift, and trigger alerts once thresholds are exceeded.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002", "T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Integrate Unity Catalog for team-based access control",
      "description": "Configure Unity Catalog roles and permissions to manage feature access, ensuring data security and compliance. Validate permissions in SDK and API calls.",
      "category": "Security",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Develop Python SDK and REST API for feature retrieval and management",
      "description": "Implement SDK methods and REST endpoints for feature registration, query, and monitoring. Include authentication and authorization integration.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 10.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-006"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Create infrastructure deployment pipeline for Feast and Redis",
      "description": "Automate infrastructure setup using DevOps scripts (Terraform/Databricks CLI). Ensure reproducibility and environment consistency across dev/stage/prod.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 10.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Document feature store architecture and usage guide",
      "description": "Create architecture diagrams, setup instructions, API usage examples, and onboarding documentation for data scientists and ML engineers.",
      "category": "Documentation",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-007"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "Feature serving latency may exceed 10ms under load.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Perform load testing early, optimize Redis configurations (sharding, caching), and monitor latency metrics continuously."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "Data duplication or inconsistency in batch updates could occur.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Implement idempotent Spark job logic and validation scripts to ensure consistent feature updates."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Access control misconfiguration may expose sensitive data.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Validate Unity Catalog policies through automated tests and restrict admin privileges during initial rollout."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Monitoring and drift detection may produce false positives.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Calibrate drift thresholds based on historical feature distributions; review alerts manually in pilot stage."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "All Feast registry components deployed and version control enabled.",
    "Batch and real-time features validated with <10ms latency at p99.",
    "Point-in-time joins verified for multiple datasets.",
    "Access control policies configured and tested with Unity Catalog.",
    "Feature monitoring dashboard reports drift metrics accurately.",
    "SDK and REST API documented and tested with sample ML workflows.",
    "Infrastructure automated via DevOps pipeline.",
    "Technical documentation reviewed and published in internal wiki."
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 76.0
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a hybrid test approach combining automated unit, integration, E2E, performance, and security testing. Utilize pytest for backend unit tests (Python SDK, Redis adapter, Feast integration), Spark testing frameworks for batch jobs, Locust or JMeter for latency and load validation, and OWASP ZAP for security scanning. Infrastructure validation through Terraform testing, plus Databricks job verification scripts. CI/CD integrated with GitHub Actions to run tests and report coverage.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Feature registration stores correct metadata and version in Feast registry",
      "description": "Verify registering a feature via API saves version, metadata, and lineage in Feast registry.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Feast repository is initialized", "User has valid access token"],
      "steps": ["Call POST /api/features/register with valid payload", "Query Feast registry for registered feature"],
      "expected_result": "Feature appears in registry with correct name, version, owner, and lineage metadata.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Batch feature computation runs successfully and updates Delta tables",
      "description": "Ensure Spark job computes features without duplication and updates Delta tables with fresh data.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Databricks workspace accessible", "Input transactions table populated"],
      "steps": ["Trigger daily Spark job on Databricks", "Query Delta table after job completion"],
      "expected_result": "Delta table contains updated feature values with current timestamp and no duplicates.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Real-time feature serving latency under 10ms for 50 concurrent requests",
      "description": "Validate that Redis-based feature serving meets latency SLA under load.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Redis cluster running", "Features preloaded in store"],
      "steps": ["Send 50 parallel GET requests for existing features", "Measure response latency (p99)"],
      "expected_result": "Each response returned in <10ms at p99 latency threshold.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Point-in-time joins retrieve correct historical feature values for training data",
      "description": "Verify that training data retrieval through Feast produces temporally accurate feature values.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Historical data available with timestamps"],
      "steps": ["Load historical event data", "Execute Feast get_historical_features call with timestamps"],
      "expected_result": "Each feature corresponds to values available before event timestamp (no leakage).",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Feature drift detection triggers alert for significant deviation",
      "description": "Confirm drift detection mechanism identifies statistical drift and generates alerts.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Offline and online stats available"],
      "steps": ["POST to /api/features/monitoring/report with large mean difference", "Check drift detection output"],
      "expected_result": "Response includes drift_detected = true and alert_id assigned.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Unity Catalog enforces team-based access control for feature retrieval",
      "description": "Ensure only authorized teams can read/write features per access level.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["Unity Catalog configured", "User teams and roles assigned"],
      "steps": ["Try to access feature without required permission", "Try again with authorized role"],
      "expected_result": "Unauthorized access denied (401), authorized access succeeds.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "API returns error for invalid registration payloads",
      "description": "Check input validation and error handling for malformed feature registration requests.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["API running"],
      "steps": ["Send POST /api/features/register with missing fields", "Observe response status and message"],
      "expected_result": "Returns HTTP 422 or 400 with validation error message; no registry update performed.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "SDK retrieves feature values via Feast correctly",
      "description": "Validate SDK client fetches correct features using Feast repository for online and historical data.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Feast client configured to correct repo path"],
      "steps": ["Invoke FeastClient.get_features() with valid entity_ids and feature_names", "Examine output tuples"],
      "expected_result": "Feature data returned matches values stored in offline/online stores with correct timestamps.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Redis adapter warns latency breach and handles missing feature gracefully",
      "description": "Ensure RedisAdapter logs latency warnings >10ms and raises exception when feature not found.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Redis client accessible"],
      "steps": ["Query non-existent feature key", "Simulate delayed response"],
      "expected_result": "Exception raised for missing feature; warning logged when latency exceeds threshold.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "Infrastructure deployment scripts create consistent environments across stages",
      "description": "Validate Terraform scripts produce identical configurations in dev/stage/prod with Feast and Redis instances.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Terraform and Databricks CLI configured"],
      "steps": ["Run terraform apply on each environment", "Compare infrastructure outputs"],
      "expected_result": "Identical configuration applied; all services operational and verified by health checks.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Sample transaction dataset with customer_id, amount, timestamp",
    "Historical event logs for point-in-time join validation",
    "Offline and online feature statistics with simulated drift conditions",
    "Team-role mapping for Unity Catalog access control",
    "Feature registration payloads with valid and invalid combinations"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Automation implemented via pytest for unit/integration tests, Databricks notebooks for batch job validation, and Locust for load testing the FastAPI endpoints. CI pipeline in GitHub Actions runs tests automatically on each commit. Integration tests mock Redis and Feast connections using pytest fixtures. Security and access tests integrated with OAuth2 token simulation. Performance data recorded through Prometheus exporters and analyzed post-test.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve 90% unit test coverage on Python SDK and API modules, 85% integration coverage across Feast, Databricks, Redis interactions, 100% test execution for critical user stories (registry, serving, joins, monitoring), and p99 latency verification for performance targets under 500 concurrent requests. Security test coverage includes all access control and authentication paths."
}

{
  "summary": "The ML Feature Store MVP unifies feature engineering across the enterprise, eliminating 60% duplicate code and reducing computation costs by 40%. Built on Feast, Redis, and Databricks, it provides versioned feature management, real-time serving, and secure access control. The solution accelerates ML development and ensures consistent training and inference performance, directly improving model reliability and reducing operational overhead.",
  "scope_overview": "The MVP delivers a centralized ML Feature Store featuring a versioned registry, batch Spark-based feature computation, real-time serving via Redis with <10ms latency, point-in-time correct training joins, drift monitoring, and secure team-level access using Unity Catalog. It integrates with Python SDK and REST API for seamless usage by data scientists and ML services.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Latency under heavy concurrent load may exceed 10ms and impact inference SLAs.",
    "Access control or metadata misconfigurations may expose sensitive data or features."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "Test coverage exceeds 85% integration and 90% unit levels across SDK, API, Redis serving, and batch jobs. Load testing confirms near 10ms p99 latency. Security and access validations via Unity Catalog and OAuth2 completed. QA automation pipeline integrated into CI/CD ensures consistent regression and performance testing.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Conduct extended performance benchmarking under production-like traffic before promotion.",
    "Implement proactive cost monitoring to ensure computation expenses remain within monthly budget."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Deploy MVP to staging environment and run end-to-end latency and drift validations.",
    "Plan next sprint to extend monitoring alerts and onboard additional feature domains for broader ML adoption."
  ]
}
